The Lobos were led by fourth year head coach [[Mike Bradbury]]. They played their home games at [[The Pit (arena)|Dreamstyle Arena]] and are a member of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. ==Previous season== They finished the previous season 24–7, 14–4 in Mountain West play to finish in second place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2019 Mountain West Conference women's basketball tournament|Mountain West Conference women's basketball tournament]] to San Diego State. They received an automatic bid to the [[2019 Women's National Invitation Tournament|Women's National Invitation Tournament]] where they got upset by Denver in the first round. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|sex=w|year=2019|team=New Mexico Lobos|teamcolors=y|high_school=y}} {{CBB roster/Player|sex=w|first=Andriana|last=Avent|link=n|num=0|pos=G|ft=5|in=10|class=Fr|rs=|home=[[Sacramento, California|Sacramento, CA]]|high_school=[[Sacramento Charter High School|Sacramento HS]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|sex=w|first=Corina|last=Carter|link=n|num=1|pos=PG|ft=5|in=6|class=Fr|rs=n|home=[[San Antonio, Texas|San Antonio, TX]]|high_school=[[Judson High School|Judson HS]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|sex=w|first=Ahlise|last=Hurst|link=n|num=3|pos=G/F|ft=5|in=9|class=So|rs=|home=[[Bendigo|Bendigo, Australia]]|high_school=[[Bendigo Senior Secondary College]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|sex=w|first=Jayla|last=Everett|link=n|num=4|pos=G|ft=5|in=10|class=So|rs=|home=[[St. Louis, Missouri|St. Louis, MO]]|high_school=[[Kirkwood High School|Kirkwood HS]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|sex=w|first=Jordan|last=Hosey|link=n|num=5|pos=F|ft=6|in=1|class=Sr|rs=|home=[[Houston|Houston, TX]]|high_school=[[Manvel High School|Manvel HS]]
